messages:
Elaine: heads-up: new pricing bakeoff v3 is staged. planning A/B cutover next Tue 09:00 PT. need final cohort freeze + grandfather rules by EOD Mon. link: https://g.co/redwood/pricing-bakeoff (gdoc).
Sam: what's the primary success metric? revenue per invoice or trial->paid conversion?
Elaine: primary = avoid invoice surprises. secondary = <3% revenue delta vs control week 1. tertiary = trial conversion lift.
Raj: billing asks: provide cohort CSV + mapping to billing_account_id. also need a reconciliation key to prevent double billing during the transition.
Marco: ops will run a 100-account canary (20 L / 40 M / 40 H). will tag canary accounts with `cutover_canary=true`. need cohort by 5pm Mon.
Olivia: Legal: customers with signed addenda must get explicit notice and be excluded unless they opt in. propose auto-grandfather for committed deals signed before 2025-06-01.
Elaine: suggested grandfather window: contracts signed before 2025-06-01 grandfathered until 2026-12-31. Others in A/B. any objections?
Sam: prefer stratified control for high-spend SKUs. Can we split control weight by usage bucket (low/med/high)?
Raj: yes. also will run a parallel metering comparison job to produce an "invoice_delta" column. sample query:
```sql
SELECT account_id, period, old_tokens, new_tokens, new_cost-old_cost AS cost_delta
FROM billing_compare
WHERE period = '2026-04'
```
Alex: support will add an admin flag `pricing_transition_exempt` users can request opt-out. we'll need docs for support flow.
Marco: ops checklist: cohort CSV, canary tag, reconciliation job runbook, staged banner, rollback toggle. I'll post runbook in #release-war-room.
billing-bot: File uploaded: pricing-bakeoff-cohort.csv (uploaded by Elaine) :file_folder:
Elaine: dropping a sample row in the doc:
```csv
account_id,usage_bucket,grandfather_until,ab_group
acct_1001,low,2026-12-31,control
acct_2042,high,,variant
```
Olivia: I'll draft the short amendment + customer notice. target to send on Tue morning only to variant group.
Sam: growth will handle banner + email. need final copy Mon 12:00 PT. @Olivia can you review?
Olivia: yes. I'll also confirm whether notice language needs translation for EU customers.
Raj: blocker: two consolidated-billing customers map to multiple sub-accounts. I'll DM details so we can exclude the parent if needed.
Elaine: final: freeze cohort at 5pm Mon. anything else?
Sam: ack. I'll monitor revenue dashboards during the week. :eyes:
Marco: ack, will run canary and report invoice shapes within 2 hours of cutover.
Elaine: thanks all. final exceptions -> drop into the sheet by 5pm. :thumbsup:
